plot_summary: Dawei Shen is the protagonist. On Friday, December 6, 2024 at 10 am, self, Jeff Bing were involved. Jeff calls Dawei to invite him to a tech panel he's hosting in Orchard County next Tuesday. Dawei agrees to attend and blocks the time in his calendar. Dawei receives an email with panel details.
user_goal: You want to see the address for the Tech Panel.

success_conditions.input_text: 1. The address linked to the calendar event Tech Panel Hosted by Jeff Bing is presented.

emails.subject: Invitation: Tech Panel Discussion on December 10
emails.body:
Hello Dawei,

I hope this message finds you well. I'm excited to invite you to a tech panel discussion I'm hosting next Tuesday, December 10, at the Tech Hub Conference Center here in Orchard County. We'll be discussing the latest trends and innovations in consumer electronics. Your insights would be incredibly valuable, and I would be thrilled if you could join us.

Please find the event details attached. Let me know if you can make it!

Best regards,
Jeff Bing

calendars.calendar_event_name: Tech Panel Hosted by Jeff Bing
calendars.location: Tech Hub Conference Center, Orchard County, CA
calendars.notes: Attending a tech panel discussion hosted by Jeff Bing on upcoming trends in consumer electronics.

contacts.address: 678 Commerce Rd, Orchard County, CA 94022, USA

query: Show me the address for the panel.
